# Template fixtures

Generic templates (`TemplateFile`, [FORMAT.md](../../../specs/FORMAT.md)) written by hand for the library. Between them they set every setting of the template format, so a host's templates can be written in it. [`template-fixtures.test.ts`](template-fixtures.test.ts) checks that each is valid, resolves over the base template with no setting missing, and gives each scope its custom properties, and that together they set every setting `TEMPLATE_SHAPE` knows (a section's settings count as the template's of the same name).

Write new text and neutral names; `npm run check:references` scans these files. A setting added to the format needs a value in one of these fixtures.

| Template         | Shape                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `field-report`   | Inherits the base. Every style, numbering with its switch, paragraph levels, a text bullet with a number prefix, contents per kind with leaders, custom styles, regions, footnotes, references, change bars, extension records, and four sections: a locked cover, a summary with a placeholder, findings, and a landscape appendix that restarts numbering, sets only its header's height and inherits its footer. |
| `field-handbook` | Inherits `field-report`. Switches paragraph numbering off, overrides one paragraph and one contents level by index, retitles the table of contents, adds a kind, and removes one extension entry.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `station-notice` | Inherits the base. US Letter landscape, unnumbered headings, a square bullet, no contents leader, per-page footnotes, one section.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
